listing.longDescription: Turn clean printed drum-notation images or visible PDF pages into validated Obsidian Drum Notation blocks. The plugin asks before guessing material ambiguities, preserves supported two-pass section repeats, and includes an import report for human review. It does not transcribe audio or handwritten scores, upload files, call external services, or write to an Obsidian vault.

starterPrompts: Transcribe this printed drum score into validated Obsidian Drum Notation and include the import report.
Convert this drum groove image into an Obsidian-ready drums block and ask about any unclear symbols.
Read this printed song chart, preserve supported section repeats, and split it only when required.
releaseNotes: Initial public-directory submission of Drum Notation Importer 0.2.1. Skills-only, network-free transcription of clean printed drum scores into validated Obsidian Drum Notation, including simple paired section repeats. Version 0.2.1 adds catalog metadata, policy pages, and a submission ZIP without changing notation-core behavior.

positiveTests.prompt: Transcribe the attached clear 4/4 printed drum groove into validated Obsidian Drum Notation and include the import report.
positiveTests.expectedWorkflow: Use import-drum-score, observe the full bar, map the three instruments, validate the block locally, and emit a schema-v1 report.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: One clean fenced drums block followed by one valid fenced drum-import-report JSON block.
positiveTests.clarificationOrRefusal: No clarification is expected because the synthetic source is clean and unambiguous.

positiveTests.prompt: Transcribe this printed bar and distinguish the crash from the recurring hi-hat using staff position.
positiveTests.expectedWorkflow: Use staff and ledger geometry before rhythmic similarity, assign the first x-notehead to crash, and validate the complete bar.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: One clean drums block with separate CR and HH rows and a valid import report containing position-evidence observations.
positiveTests.clarificationOrRefusal: Ask for a focused crop only if the ledger relationship cannot be resolved at the supplied scale.

positiveTests.prompt: Transcribe this printed groove, preserve the ornament, and account for the explicit lower-voice rest.
positiveTests.expectedWorkflow: Distinguish the visible grace note from a stem slash, preserve the silent lower-voice span, validate, and report the hidden-rest-glyph limitation.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: One valid split-voice drums block and a report with an appearance workaround for the explicit lower-voice rest glyph.
positiveTests.clarificationOrRefusal: Ask rather than choose flam or diddle if the ornament detail is unresolved.

positiveTests.prompt: Transcribe this two-bar printed section and preserve the clearly paired two-pass repeat signs.
positiveTests.expectedWorkflow: Confirm both boundaries and the two-pass route, preserve the span with native bracket markers, and validate it as one block.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: One clean drums block containing native [ and ] section markers and a valid report with no repeat workaround loss.
positiveTests.clarificationOrRefusal: Ask before output if either boundary or traversal count is unclear.

positiveTests.prompt: Transcribe this complete printed chart with both tempo regions and include the import report.
positiveTests.expectedWorkflow: Observe both systems, transcribe every bar, split at the tempo change because tempo is block-level, and validate both blocks.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: Two justified fenced drums blocks, one per tempo region, followed by one schema-v1 report covering both segments.
positiveTests.clarificationOrRefusal: No section may be omitted; ask if the tempo marking cannot be read.

negativeTests.prompt: Transcribe this attached drum audio track into Obsidian Drum Notation.
negativeTests.expectedWorkflow: Do not invoke image transcription or emit provisional notation.
negativeTests.expectedResultShape: A concise explanation that audio transcription is unsupported in this importer version.
negativeTests.clarificationOrRefusal: Ask the user to provide a clean printed score image or visible PDF page instead.
negativeTests.whyNotComplete: Importer 0.2.1 has no audio transcription model or audio-analysis workflow.

negativeTests.prompt: Convert this handwritten and unreadable drum notation into a drums block.
negativeTests.expectedWorkflow: Recognize that the source is outside the clean printed input scope and emit no drums block.
negativeTests.expectedResultShape: A request for a clean printed image or a clearer focused crop, with no provisional transcription.
negativeTests.clarificationOrRefusal: State which visual details are unreadable and stop.
negativeTests.whyNotComplete: Guessing from unreadable handwriting would produce an unreliable score.

negativeTests.prompt: Transcribe this song chart with first and second endings plus D.S. al Coda.
negativeTests.expectedWorkflow: Identify unsupported endings and navigation before output and do not silently flatten the route.
negativeTests.expectedResultShape: A clarification asking whether the user approves an explicit flattened route or wants to defer the chart.
negativeTests.clarificationOrRefusal: Emit no provisional drums block until the route and flattening approval are explicit.
negativeTests.whyNotComplete: Notation core 1.6.0 cannot represent first or second endings, D.S., Segno, or Coda natively.

localActivationTests.prompt: Compose an original funk drum groove from scratch.
localActivationTests.expectedBehavior: Do not activate the transcription skill; explain that it converts supplied printed scores rather than composing new material.
